authorized_scope: Exact inventory pending refs only; opaque byte transfers and metadata classification; no scientific interpretation, private keys or raw native mixed-schema bodies. Publisher owns Git.

classifiers.actual_Task: Eligible exact owner-authenticated launched/prepared Task and prompt text, with CURRENT/HISTORY/PREPARED distinctions; verify pin and length, no rewriting.
classifiers.actual_tool_config: Eligible actual candidate-facing tools/config source only after explicit field/type inspection for credentials/auth/session/private host values. Unknown mixed/private schema quarantined, with exact opaque locator/SHA and reason; do not substitute source-template as actual runtime config.
classifiers.OPAQUE_AUTHORED_ARTIFACT: Eligible frozen candidate-authored proposal/catalog/review/amendment/source-check code/map and exact current outputs; preserve original required/noncanonical/partial and SAME-CANDIDATE report provenance. Raw source capture bodies remain external NAS boundary even if captured by candidate; no private operational receipt/modelIO payload.
classifiers.actual_stage: Do not blanket publish full stage.json. Mixed coordinator stage may contain native configuration and private references; select exact safe existing owner projection/source-authenticated public stage definition or quarantine original with SHA/type reason. Actual candidate Task/tool/output bodies receive separate grants.
classifiers.output_freeze: Use existing credential-free inventory projection and exact original receipt locator/SHA; full receipt only after owner-safe field classification. No promotion from native status or artifact presence.

always_external_or_excluded: private phase2 alias keys or answer keys
native result payload/objectives/config mixed raw native body
raw public source captures: external NAS manifest locator+SHA, not Git
qualification: No perfect blinding/firewall or all-version retention claim: inventory broad parse incident151 reconstructed/86 current and lost overwritten draft bytes retained as explicit limits. Extant eligible assets cannot remain pending at final completion; genuine exclusion/quarantine must state exact reason.
